description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 14.12.2020 to 20.12.2020
categorisation: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) that establishes new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges. It rescinds a previous notification and sets legal/regulatory requirements for financial transactions related to customs. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory framework matters.
